label: 标准灵梦 · 茎生复合动作 v2
composition: Adult mother and one forward arched main stalk
Solid tapered pedicels thinner than their main-stalk attachment
1–5 sleeping offspring growing on the stem
Sequential detachment, juvenile birth events, landing and waking
constraints: Pedicel radius at most 60% of local main-stalk radius; tapered tip 78% of base
Count chosen once per pregnancy and persisted
recorded_rules: Offspring count affects stem length and thickness
Individual variation exists in these relationships
deferred: Complete maternal-size/count/stem-dimension relationship: recorded only; numerical mapping and variation distribution unspecified
Stalk root detachment and item 油库里的茎: recorded only
